series_end_reason: AbbVie's 2024Q4 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000155115225000011/abbv-20241231xexhibit991.htm) is the last to print a Restasis row ('Restasis 102 | 12 | 114'); from the 2025Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000155115225000026/abbv-20250331xexhibit991.htm) the Eye Care block lists only Ozurdex, Lumigan/Ganfort, Alphagan/Combigan and 'Other Eye Care', the word Restasis appears nowhere in that release, and the FY2025 10-K states 'Other eye care products include Refresh/Optive, Xen, Durysta and Restasis' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000155115226000008/abbv-20251231.htm).
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms, incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K) for CIK 0001551152 (AbbVie), 0000001800 (Abbott), 0001578845 (Allergan plc / Actavis plc), 0000855654 (ImmunoGen) and 0000850693 (Allergan, Inc.) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (scripts/list_filings.py); earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02 (also item 12 / 7,9 for 2003-2004 Abbott and Allergan, Inc. filings), exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (scripts/earnings.py, exhibits.py).

Product rows pulled by table-row parsing of each earnings exhibit (scripts/abbvie_extract.py, abbott_extract.py, allergan_extract.py, allerganinc_extract.py); the quarter of an AbbVie block is read from the document's own '% Change vs. nQyy' header row; every series was checked for gaps and, where the Q4 release prints a full-year figure, quarters were summed against it (scripts/build_all.py).

Launch evidence: Allergan, Inc. release filed 2003-04-28 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/850693/000089256903001079/a89547exv99w1.htm): 'Allergan launched Restasis in the United States in April of 2003'; release filed 2003-07-23 states the quarter ended June 27, 2003 Restasis sales were $11.8 million, 'the initial launch quarter'.

Four quarters of each of 2004-2014 sum to the full-year Restasis figure printed in the Q4 release (2005 differs by 0.1 from rounding); 2003 (Q2-Q4 = 38.4) vs printed 38.3 differs by 0.1 from rounding.

Allergan, Inc.'s releases for 2003 through 2007 print fiscal quarter ends on the last Friday of the quarter (e.g. September 26, 2003), a few days before the calendar quarter end in some quarters; these are mapped to the calendar quarter and each row states the printed date.

unreported_quarters.2015Q1: Ownership change Allergan to Allergan plc; no full-quarter figure is published. Allergan, Inc. was acquired by Actavis plc on March 17, 2015 (Allergan plc 10-Q for 2016Q1) and filed no 2015Q1 earnings release; the last quarter it reported is 2014Q4 (release filed 2015-02-04). The acquirer's series is allergan_restasis (2015Q2 on). Allergan plc acquired Allergan, Inc. on March 17, 2015 (10-Q for 2016Q1: 'On March 17, 2015, the Company acquired Legacy Allergan'); its 2015Q1 Restasis figure (29.9) covers only the post-close stub and Allergan, Inc. filed no 2015Q1 report, so the first full quarter is 2015Q2. Allergan, Inc.'s own 2003Q2-2014Q4 series is staged as allergan_inc_restasis.
unreported_quarters.2020Q2: Ownership change Allergan plc to AbbVie; no full-quarter figure is published. Allergan plc was acquired by AbbVie on May 8, 2020; its last periodic report is the 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2020. AbbVie's 2020Q2 figure covers only the post-close period; the AbbVie-era series is abbvie_restasis (2020Q3-2024Q4). AbbVie-reported series starts 2020Q3. AbbVie's 2020Q2 release prints Restasis $144 million covering only the post-close period from May 8, 2020 (footnote 'Net revenues include Allergan product revenues from the date of the acquisition, May 8, 2020, through June 30, 2020'), so 2020Q2 is excluded. Earlier owners' own series are staged separately: allergan_restasis (Allergan plc 2015Q2-2020Q1) and allergan_inc_restasis (Allergan, Inc. 2003Q2-2014Q4). Restasis launched in the U.S. in April 2003 (Allergan, Inc. 2003-04-28 release: 'Allergan launched Restasis in the United States in April of 2003').
